name: Foptimum
description: An internet uptime monitoring tool that serves stats using Prometheus.

ports.name: Prometheus Server Port
ports.description: The port where Prometheus will be exposing result data

variables.name: Speedtest Interval
variables.description: How often in seconds the speedtest will run (set to 0 to disable speed test)

variables.name: Ping Interval
variables.description: How often in seconds to ping servers in the server list (set to 0 to disable pings)

variables.name: Server List
variables.description: Comma delimited list of IPs to ping
